standard: ECMA-376 Part2, fifth edition, December2021, Open Packaging Conventions

clauses.supports: General packaging conventions apply to varied content and markup specifications; not an XLSX part-name roster.
Part-name grammar, reserved relationships names, case-insensitive equivalence/integrity constraints. No universal finite app-specific filename whitelist.
Each part has a MIME media type; non-Relationships parts receive Default/Override coverage, with overrides taking precedence and duplicate declarations constrained.

Content-specific payload references may exist. Relationships expose a separate graph; targets have internal/external modes and source-dependent base IRIs. Internal is the default; external targets are permitted in OPC.
[Content_Types].xml stores the Media Types stream in the ordinary noninterleaved ZIP case; it is not an ordinary part under the abstract naming grammar.

interpretation: An app-specific finite whitelist is a restricted reader profile, not OPC universal part naming. Opaque payload handling is not proof of harmlessness or workbook semantic validity. No particular unknown Li member or failure is asserted.
